methods_quotes.q: Each case was weighted based on the inverse probability of the hospital being selected, and the weights were summed to produce national estimates
95% confidence intervals were calculated using statistical software that accounted for the sample weights and complex sampling design
If the sample count was <20 or the coefficient of variation was >30%, the estimate was unstable and not reported.
Rates by incident location and race/ethnicity are not reported because of the high percentage of patients with unknown race/ethnicity.
